start: Sign in as owner; the gym has members, payments and check-ins

steps.action: Open the panel (Today is the first screen)
user_sees: Title 'Today' with today's date; at the top, anything waiting for the owner; the quick buttons with 'Change buttons'; tiles 'Today's collection', 'Active members', 'Ending today', 'Ending in 1-3 days', 'Ending in 4-7 days', 'Ending in 8-15 days', 'Expired', 'Fees due', 'Birthdays today', 'Came in today', 'Enquiries to call'
must_not: A wall of zeros for a brand-new gym
A cancelled receipt counted in 'Today's collection'
Archived members' dues dropped from 'Fees due'

user_sees: The Members list filtered by the same rule, with the same number of rows as the tile
must_not: A tile number that differs from the list it opens

steps.action: Read 'Talk to these members', 'Money to collect' and 'Losing the habit'
user_sees: People whose plan is ending or ended lately; the 6 biggest dues with '{amount} due' and 'See all'; paying members who stopped coming
must_not: A member who left two years ago under 'Talk to these members'
'Everybody is training' when no check-ins exist (it must say 'Start checking members in')

user_sees: WhatsApp opens for that member's number
must_not: WhatsApp opened for another member
A message sent by the panel itself

user_sees: Sheet 'Quick buttons': 'Pick up to {max} buttons and put them in order. Staff see only the ones they may use.'; a tick box per button and up / down arrows for the ticked ones
must_not: More than the most allowed ticked
A button that opens a page this gym does not have

steps.action: Tick two buttons, move one earlier with the arrow, tap 'Done'
user_sees: The buttons on Today in the new order
must_not: The choice lost on reload
The choice missing on the owner's other device or at the front desk

user_sees: The page it names (for example add a member or collect a payment)
must_not: A page the role may not open

steps.action: In 'Money to collect' tap the member's name; go back; tap 'Message'
user_sees: The member's page; then WhatsApp for the number shown in the link's tooltip 'WhatsApp {number}'
must_not: WhatsApp opened for a number that is not complete
The row's two tap targets overlapping on a 360 px phone

steps.action: In 'Money to collect' tap the member's name; go back; tap 'Message'
user_sees: The member's page; then WhatsApp for the number shown in the link's tooltip 'WhatsApp {number}'
must_not: WhatsApp opened for a number that is not complete
The row's two tap targets overlapping on a 360 px phone

start: Today on a brand-new gym with no members, sales, payments, visits or enquiries

user_sees: No tiles and no lists; the gym code and shop cards; the first steps live on 'Set up your gym'
must_not: Eleven tiles of 0
'Everyone has paid' for a gym with no members
An error

user_sees: The tiles and lists come back by themselves
must_not: Tiles still hidden after the first record

steps.action: A member asks 'Renew my plan' in the app; approve it on Today with one tap
user_sees: The request leaves the card; the member's plan and dues change once
must_not: The request approved twice
The card still showing it after a refresh

steps.action: Collect a due from 'Money to collect', come back to Today
user_sees: The member is gone from the list; 'Fees due' drops and 'Today's collection' rises by the same amount
must_not: The old amounts until a full reload

user_sees: The week summary card (owner only)
must_not: Last week's card on a Tuesday
Sunday counted in the new week

user_sees: The gym's own money totals and members
must_not: Another gym's or another branch's totals mixed in
A member's phone number in a page address

user_sees: 'Today' with the people tiles ('Active members', the 'Ending…' tiles, 'Expired', 'Birthdays today', 'Came in today', 'Enquiries to call'); no 'Today's collection', no 'Fees due', no week summary, no AI card, no trial line, no 'Change buttons'
must_not: Any money total for staff
A gap where the owner's tiles would be
'Set up your gym' in the menu

steps.action: Tap 'Came in today', then a quick button
user_sees: The check-in list; then the page the button names
must_not: A quick button to a page staff may not open (Expenses, Messages, the AI Assistant)

user_sees: Each page refuses or sends staff back; never the totals
must_not: Money owed, growth or all-branch totals shown to staff
A blank page with no way back

user_sees: It is not there: the owner picks the buttons
must_not: Staff changing the gym's buttons

start: Today as front desk with things waiting

steps.action: Someone filled the gym's 'Become a member' page; tap 'Make member' on the 'Joined online' card after they pay
user_sees: The person becomes a member once; the card row goes
must_not: Two members for one request
The request still waiting on the owner's device

steps.action: A member typed their phone number in the app; approve it on the phone-links card
user_sees: The link is approved once and the row goes
must_not: A stranger's phone linked to a member without the desk's tap

user_sees: Names with each person's own '{amount} due'
must_not: The total of all dues
Collections of the day or month
